bern.finding: SBB locates platforms 49 and 50 in the western extension of platforms 9 and 10 towards Fribourg. It also notes ongoing station construction.
bern.inference: Use the exact Bern operating point and the existing standard-gauge SBB Bern–Bern JKLM source curve to reach the exact GTFS platform-50 coordinate. No platform-specific track centreline or live diversion is certified.
bern.relatedReview: data/aargau-platform-policy.json; independently revalidated here for platform 50 and both IR35 operators.

basel.finding: DB InfraGO and SBB describe joint operating interfaces on Basel Bad Bf–Gellert–Basel SBB passenger/freight station infrastructure. This supports the existing FOT DICH segment identity in the cross-infrastructure corridor; no curve is traced from the document.

reuse.geometry: Only the existing attributed FOT geometry is used; source reuse terms remain unchanged. Official descriptive pages and operating guidance support identity, not a new openly licensed alignment.
